title: lasianthus verticillatus
intro: Lasianthus verticillatus, commonly known as Whorled Lasianthus, is a plant species that belongs to the family Theaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lasianthus verticillatus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral effects.
